text: {"40":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":["src/backend/access/heap"],"why":"BRIN indexes do not store heap TIDs and therefore need no scan for heap-tuple removal."},"41":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":["src/backend/access/heap"],"why":"BRIN summary values may become tighten-able after heap tuple deletion without affecting correctness."},"42":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":[],"why":"BRIN handles deleted-tuple effects by re-summarizing the affected page range."},"43":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":[],"why":"The described BRIN re-summarization optimization is not implemented."},"44":{"about":["src/backend/access/brin"],"refers":[],"why":"Having only a BRIN index avoids a detailed index scan during vacuum and can reduce maintenance memory."}}
